s1.desc: a dining room drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a round window showing a sunny sky behind her

beats.text: Polly sits at the table pouring cucumber water from a glass pitcher into a jar
Polly sets the pitcher down beside her and picks up the jar
Polly tips her head back and drinks from the jar
Polly lowers the jar to the table and reaches for a carrot stick on her plate
Polly lifts the carrot stick to her beak and bites into it
Polly crunches on the carrot with her eyes closed and a content smile, holding it out to her side

props: plate of carrot and celery sticks
spans.notes: keep12 is low because Polly moves a lot; motion bands all contain Polly or the pitcher, so compare decides: 0/60, 60/119 and 0/119 window frame, table edge and plate edges black, diff map blank on the background. Top third plain wall, bottom fifth plain table, no overlay

spans.view: with a round window behind her and a table crowded with food

beats.text: Polly sits behind plates of pancakes, macarons, sandwiches and a long sushi roll, forking food into her beak
Polly lifts a sandwich to her beak and takes a big bite with her eyes closed
Polly chews happily with her eyes closed, a fork in her flipper
Polly forks another bite from the pancakes and eats it
Polly sits still looking ahead, holding the fork up beside her
Polly flings the fork away and grabs the tray of sushi
Polly lifts the sushi tray up toward her face
Polly tips the tray against her face with her eyes closed, sushi slices sliding toward her beak as a few tumble off
